Github Copilot reset the tokens on June 30, but it won't charge you for the next month until Jul 2nd.

I finished using up all my tokens tonight, then cancel my subscription, so I don't have to pay for the next month.

You just need to have 2 Copilot accounts and alternate using each of them every other month, so that you can double your tokens for the same price.
